housing.summary: Bray 1-bedroom apartments listed at approximately EUR 1,650-2,050 per month on Daft.ie (Sea Gardens EUR 2,050; Meath Road EUR 1,650; Upper Dargle Road EUR 1,600). Bray is a coastal commuter town in Co. Wicklow with DART rail access to Dublin. Deposit norm is typically one to two months rent.

banking.summary: To open a bank account in Ireland, newcomers need photo ID (passport), proof of address (utility bill or tenancy agreement dated within 3 months), and PPS number if employed. AIB and Bank of Ireland both operate in Bray.
required_docs: Proof of address (utility bill or tenancy agreement dated within 3 months)

schools.summary: No IB or international curriculum schools confirmed via source fetch specifically for Bray. The main national schools directory is via the Department of Education. Families may access Dublin-area international schools given the DART commute proximity.

legal_admin.summary: Non-EU expats staying more than 90 days must register with Immigration Service Delivery (ISD) within 90 days of arrival to obtain an Irish Residence Permit (IRP). Registration is done via the ISD online customer portal. Fee is EUR 300.
legal_admin.registration_step: Book an appointment via the ISD online customer portal at irishimmigration.ie; attend with passport, permission letter and supporting documents; pay EUR 300 fee; receive IRP card by post.

tax_finance.summary: A PPS number is obtained by applying online via MyWelfare.ie (if you have a MyGovID account) or by booking an in-person appointment at your local Intreo centre or DSP office. You need photo ID and proof of address.

transport.summary: Bray is served by DART (Dublin Area Rapid Transit) rail and Bus Eireann bus routes. It is in the commuter rail zone for Dublin. Monthly adult TFI Leap Card for Zone 1+2 (covering Bray-Dublin DART corridor) is EUR 129.50. EU/EEA licence holders can exchange at NDLS. Newcomers register with a local GP; medical card via HSE mywelfare.ie.
transport.driving_licence_exchange: EU/EEA licence holders can exchange for an Irish licence at any NDLS centre (fee EUR 65); non-EU licence holders from recognised states may also exchange; others must pass Irish driving test. Apply at ndls.ie.
transport.healthcare_registration: Contact a local GP practice directly to register as a patient. To apply for a medical card (free GP services), apply via mywelfare.ie or HSE. Ordinary residence (1 year intent) required for full HSE entitlement.
